title: compadd -X leaves %F %K %H %{%} and the %B/%U/%S attributes unexpanded

spec.completer:
#compdef fzcx

compadd -J gB -X '%Bbold%b' -- b1 b2
compadd -J gU -X '%Uunder%u' -- u1 u2
compadd -J gS -X '%Sstand%s' -- s1 s2
compadd -J gF -X '%F{red}fg%f' -- f1 f2
compadd -J gK -X '%K{blue}bg%k' -- k1 k2
compadd -J gH -X '%Hhi%h' -- h1 h2
compadd -J gZ -X '%{X%}zero' -- z1 z2
compadd -J gP -X '100%% pct' -- p1 p2

observed.notes: One completer adds eight groups, each with a different escape in its -X explanation. %F{red} -> zshrs prints the literal '{red}'; %H -> zshrs prints 'Hhih'; %{X%} -> zshrs leaves a stray '%'. %B/%U/%S produce identical TEXT but zshrs emits no SGR at all (rows 1/3/5 differ in attributes only, so --compare-attrs is required to fail them). Only %% behaved identically. The trailing \e[K in the raw diff is fixture listing_row_erase_to_eol showing through.

variants.note: fuzz-found witness for %K{blue}, confirmed 2026-08-30 (FAIL, 1 row): zsh 'bg expl' vs zshrs '{blue}bg expl'.
fuzz-found witness for %{...%}, confirmed 2026-08-30 (FAIL, 1 row): zsh '\e[32mzero-width\e[0m expl' vs zshrs '\e[32m%zero-width\e[0m% expl' — the %{ %} delimiters survive.
attribute-only witness, confirmed 2026-08-30 (FAIL only under --compare-attrs): %B/%U/%S text matches, SGR does not.

confirmed.note: all three harness files had uncommitted edits when this was confirmed (three agents were editing them concurrently); the sha256 prefixes above pin the exact bytes used.
